title: Hawaiian Diving Adventures

services.name: Fun Dive
services.desc: The local diving community on Oahu has been underserved for years. We have engineered our dive club to be community building through discounted dives and courses as well as our non-diving events and activities that can include the whole family and friend group. Closely tied into our club and community is our shop and store focused on being a hub of knowledge, experience, and service to make all aspects of diving on this island safe, accessible, and affordable. We all want a thriving local diving community, so let’s start building one! Check out some upcoming special club dives and activities. Remember, only club members get club pricing.
